## Jev as a gate on Sonnet's ring calls

Rule: keep a Sonnet ring call only when Jev's signal for that neighborhood is at or above the threshold; a dropped call becomes 'ordinary' with nothing flagged. Threshold chosen on the main slice against Sonnet v3, then applied unchanged to heldout_a. Sonnet v3 was never run on heldout_a (only v1 and v2 exist there), so the held-out test gates Sonnet v2 (facts, no Knowledge Base lookup); the same gate on v2 of the main slice is shown for a like-for-like read.
